answer: Bind the per-epoch stamp to a hash of the identity's OWN public key plus the fresh seed, so no two identities can share one grind — work done for a knoll of one fake is worthless for the next. A thousand clones face a thousand distinct puzzles, each a glacier of sequential compute against an unpredictable target; there is no violet thread of shared precomputation. Cost scales with head count, exactly, every round.
